name: droid_app.clear_app_data
description: Clear the application's data with pm clear. Requires confirm: true, because it is the only tool here that destroys state on a device somebody else may be using.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

package.description: Android application id. Required: two application ids can be installed at once and both open a WebView DevTools socket.

confirm.description: Must be true. Second explicit act before data loss.

name: droid_app.install_app
description: Install an APK and verify with pm list packages that the named package is present afterwards. A signature mismatch (INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE) is reported with the uninstall-first remedy.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

package.description: Android application id. Required: two application ids can be installed at once and both open a WebView DevTools socket.

apkPath.description: Path to the APK on this machine.

name: droid_app.read_app_file
description: Read a file back out of the application's private files/ directory through run-as.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

package.description: Android application id. Required: two application ids can be installed at once and both open a WebView DevTools socket.

relativePath.description: Path under the app's files/ directory. May not escape it.

maxBytes.description: Truncate the returned content to this many bytes.

name: droid_app.start_app
description: Launch the application, by explicit activity with am start -W, or through the launcher intent. Returns the resumed activity and, when am start reported it, the measured total start time.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

package.description: Android application id. Required: two application ids can be installed at once and both open a WebView DevTools socket.

waitForResume.description: Poll dumpsys until the package is the resumed activity.

resumeTimeoutMs.description: Deadline for that poll in milliseconds. Default 15000.

viaLauncherIntent.description: Use monkey with the LAUNCHER category instead of am start.

name: droid_app.stop_app
description: Force-stop the application.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

package.description: Android application id. Required: two application ids can be installed at once and both open a WebView DevTools socket.

name: droid_app.uninstall_app
description: Uninstall a package. With tolerateMissing, a package that was not installed is not an error.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

package.description: Android application id. Required: two application ids can be installed at once and both open a WebView DevTools socket.

tolerateMissing.description: Treat an absent package as success.

name: droid_app.write_app_file
description: Write a file into the application's private files/ directory through run-as. This is how the app is configured before launch. A run-as refusal on a non-debuggable build is reported rather than read as success.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

package.description: Android application id. Required: two application ids can be installed at once and both open a WebView DevTools socket.

relativePath.description: Path under the app's files/ directory. May not escape it.

name: droid_assert.assert_not_visible
description: Assert no node matching the predicates is visible. The check that catches a whole-app crash is a negative assertion on the error-boundary title, which both the application shell and the page boundary render.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

name.description: Artifact base name for the evidence pair.

match.description: Predicates the node must satisfy. At least one is required.

resourceId.description: Exact resource-id. In a WebView this is the element's HTML id attribute, NOT its data-testid: an element that sets only a testid cannot be addressed this way.

text.description: Exact match on the node's whole text. Inline spans merge into the row.

textPattern.description: Regular expression against text; the way to match part of a row.

requireOnScreen.description: Require the node's bounds to intersect the screen. Default true.

timeoutMs.description: Re-capture until the predicate holds. Default: one capture.

runRoot.description: Directory to write artifacts into instead of this run's default directory.

name: droid_assert.assert_visible
description: Assert a node matching the predicates is present, enabled and on screen. Decided from the accessibility hierarchy, never from image comparison. A false assertion returns passed: false with evidence, not an error.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

name.description: Artifact base name for the evidence pair.

match.description: Predicates the node must satisfy. At least one is required.

resourceId.description: Exact resource-id. In a WebView this is the element's HTML id attribute, NOT its data-testid: an element that sets only a testid cannot be addressed this way.

text.description: Exact match on the node's whole text. Inline spans merge into the row.

textPattern.description: Regular expression against text; the way to match part of a row.

requireOnScreen.description: Require the node's bounds to intersect the screen. Default true.

timeoutMs.description: Re-capture until the predicate holds. Default: one capture.

runRoot.description: Directory to write artifacts into instead of this run's default directory.

name: droid_capture.logcat
description: Clear the log buffer, or dump it with optional line, format, package and tag filters. Regular expressions in filters are applied here and reported as matchedCount plus the matching lines; the full log is still written.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

mode.description: clear runs logcat -c; dump runs logcat -d.

name.description: Artifact base name for the log. Default logcat.

package.description: Resolve this package's pid and pass --pid.

requireRuntimeContent.description: Fail when the capture contains no runtime content at all. Default false.

maxBytes.description: Cap on the captured buffer. Default 32 MiB.

runRoot.description: Directory to write artifacts into instead of this run's default directory.

name: droid_capture.screenshot
description: Capture a PNG screenshot and write both a raw copy and a 480 px review copy. The PNG signature is checked at capture time, so a zero-byte capture fails here rather than at evidence validation later.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

maxDimension.description: Hard cap on either review dimension. Default 1999.

runRoot.description: Directory to write artifacts into instead of this run's default directory.

name: droid_capture.start_recording
description: Start screenrecord detached and return a handle. The time limit is returned so a caller can tell a recording that outlived its limit from one that stopped early.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

name.description: Artifact base name for the MP4.

runRoot.description: Directory to write artifacts into instead of this run's default directory.

name: droid_capture.stop_recording
description: Stop a recording, pull the MP4 and delete it from the device. The ftyp box is checked on pull. A recording whose file is missing at stop time is reported as a failed result with the paths, not as an exception.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

name: droid_capture.ui_hierarchy
description: Capture the uiautomator hierarchy, with the settle poll, retry budget and per-call deadline that a wedged dump requires. Falls back to dumping to /dev/tty when the device has no writable /sdcard.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

settleTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the dump file to stop growing.

attempts.description: Whole-capture attempts before falling back. Default 3.

runRoot.description: Directory to write artifacts into instead of this run's default directory.

name: droid_device.forward_webview
description: Forward a local TCP port to the named application's WebView DevTools socket. The package is required because two application ids can be installed at once and both open a socket. Every rebuild invalidates the forward.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

package.description: Android application id. Required: two application ids can be installed at once and both open a WebView DevTools socket.

replaceExisting.description: Remove an existing forward on that port first. Default true.

name: droid_device.prepare_device
description: Bring a device to a state a test can run against: booted, unlocked, awake, optionally with animations off, and report the resumed activity, focused window and any wm size or wm density override.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

disableAnimations.description: Set the three global animation scales to 0.

requireNativeGeometry.description: Fail when wm size or wm density reports an override. A leftover small-screen override fails input and clarity checks with no code fault at all.

timeoutMs.description: Deadline for the boot wait. Default 120000.

name: droid_device.pull_file
description: Copy a file off the device to a local path.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

name: droid_device.push_file
description: Copy a local file onto the device.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

name: droid_device.run_shell
description: Run an arbitrary command on the device. command is an argument array, so no shell line is built by concatenation. The escape hatch for operations that have no typed tool, not a substitute for the typed ones.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

command.description: Argument vector, not a shell string.

stdin.description: Sent to the command's standard input.

name: droid_input.input_text
description: Type text through adb input text. The keypad target has no IME, so prefer press_key there.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

name: droid_input.press_key
description: Send a key event. keycode accepts an Android name such as KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN or a number; the table is served as the droidctl://reference/keycodes resource. This is the primary input tool on a keypad-only target.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

keycode.description: Android keycode number or KEYCODE_ name.

repeat.description: Send the key this many times. Default 1.

name: droid_input.swipe
description: Swipe between two points over a duration.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

units.description: Coordinate space. adb input speaks physical pixels while the DOM speaks CSS pixels; with css the server multiplies by dpr once, instead of each caller doing it.

dpr.description: Device pixel ratio. Required when units is css.

name: droid_input.tap
description: Tap at a point, or press and hold when hold is given. A hold uses motionevent DOWN/UP with an explicit release rather than input tap, because the application treats a tap and a hold as different gestures.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

units.description: Coordinate space. adb input speaks physical pixels while the DOM speaks CSS pixels; with css the server multiplies by dpr once, instead of each caller doing it.

dpr.description: Device pixel ratio. Required when units is css.

hold.description: Hold duration in milliseconds. Omit for a plain tap.

name: droid_target.describe_target
description: Describe one target: build properties, screen geometry, and any wm size or wm density override. A leftover override from a small-screen audit fails input and clarity checks with no code fault, so it is reported here.

targetId.description: Target id from droid_target.list_targets. There is no default target and no single-device fallback.

name: droid_target.list_targets
description: List every addressable target with its transport, serial, model, API level, state and whether it is an emulator. Returns no default, preferred or current target: pick one and pass its targetId. Offline and unauthorized targets are listed rather than hidden, so a caller can see why its target vanished. apiLevel is read once per connection and is null only for a target that cannot be queried, which is every target not in state device.

transports.description: Restrict enumeration to these transports. Omit to enumerate all registered transports.
